# Studies: Candlestick patterns

Line: `ta.name(parameters) -> outputs · placement · needs · title`. Legend in the studies skill: `name:type=default[min..max]`, `select` shows `{allowed|strings}`, no `=default` means required, `[a, b]` is a tuple to destructure in that order.

Every pattern returns one series (`signal`): `na` while warming up, `0` for no pattern, a positive value for a bullish pattern and a negative one for a bearish pattern (the size is the strength: 100 is a full signal, an engulfing also returns 80; neutral patterns such as the doji return 100). Test it with a comparison, `ta.cdl_doji() != 0`.

Patterns with parameters:

- `ta.cdl_abandonedbaby(penetration:float=0.3[0..10])` -> series · overlay · needs ohlc · Abandoned Baby
- `ta.cdl_darkcloudcover(penetration:float=0.5[0..10])` -> series · overlay · needs ohlc · Dark Cloud Cover
- `ta.cdl_eveningdojistar(penetration:float=0.3[0..10])` -> series · overlay · needs ohlc · Evening Doji Star
- `ta.cdl_eveningstar(penetration:float=0.3[0..10])` -> series · overlay · needs ohlc · Evening Star
- `ta.cdl_mathold(penetration:float=0.5[0..10])` -> series · overlay · needs ohlc · Mat Hold
- `ta.cdl_morningdojistar(penetration:float=0.3[0..10])` -> series · overlay · needs ohlc · Morning Doji Star
- `ta.cdl_morningstar(penetration:float=0.3[0..10])` -> series · overlay · needs ohlc · Morning Star
